character.name: Saigo
character.text:
You may take a dead player's Stance into your hand. Bare hands deal 2. In the draw phase, +1 card per Stance on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} your Stance stays, and enemies return their Stances to hand.

hand.name: Shogun's Wrath
hand.text: This attack may be made even against a player at death's door.

hand.name: Uchine
hand.text: If your attack is stopped by a Defense, the weapon comes back to your hand along its cord.

hand.name: Yari
hand.text: {Polearm} In the {Horseman} stance, deals 1 extra wound.

hand.name: Ketsu Nugi
hand.text:
Take one life from a player and add it to your own.
{If you are Poisoned}, you pass the Poison to that player instead.

hand.name: Boomerang
hand.text: On a successful attack, this weapon returns to your hand.

hand.name: Bell
hand.text: When it is triggered, any {ally} may play their own Trap in its place as an Intervention — from hand or from the table.

hand.name: Peacemakers
hand.text: Each other living player discards a Defense or a Weapon, or hands you a card of their choice from their hand.

hand.name: Kubitori
hand.text:
+1 attack power. If this attack kills the enemy, you may take their Stance, Aura and any Effects for yourself.
The only way to take {Saigo}'s Stance.

stance.name: Mushin
stance.text:
{At full health} draw 2 cards when you make a direct attack.
{At death's door} your attacks deal 2 extra wounds.

effects.name: Killer's Mark
effects.text:
Every attack against you deals 1 extra wound, and the attacker draws a card.
{The player who kills you} draws two cards.

character.name: Hanzo
character.text:
You may block direct attacks with a weapon at the cost of one wound. You may discard a Defense to draw 2.
{After your death} discard any number of Weapons: a thrust for 1 wound each, all at one enemy.

character.name: Taka
character.text:
Once per turn: take a card of a player's choice from them, or give them one of yours. Once per turn: discard 2 cards to draw 3.
{After your death} you may give allies a card each, face down.

character.name: Saigo
character.text:
You may take a dead player's Stance into your hand. Bare hands deal 2. In the draw phase, +1 card per Stance on the table (up to 3).
{After your death} your Stance stays, and enemies return their Stances to hand.

character.name: Minamoto
character.text:
Poison costs you no life, and a poison death's point is yours, not the discard's. {If you are poisoned}: your attacks are poisoned, 3 attempts per turn, and whoever wounds you with a direct attack is poisoned. In the draw phase, +1 card per poisoned player (up to 3).
{After your death} every enemy is poisoned.

log_this_turn: P0 (Hanzo) plans: Kill Taka (5→6 VP), damage Minamoto, weaken enemy responses with Peacemakers.

P0 (Hanzo) strikes P1 (Taka) with Kanabo + Finishing Blow; P3 (Minamoto) intervenes with Parry and Block, two teammate Defenses capping the hit at 0 wounds, but the successful strike still makes Taka discard a random card.

ruling on 1081: Finishing Blow computes power from missing life (5-3=2), but does that matter once two teammate Defenses cap wounds at 0? -> No: two Defense cards played as intervention override the final wound count to 0 regardless of the modifier's computed power; the weapon's on-hit text still fires because the attack was not fully blocked by the defender's own Defense.
P0 (Hanzo) attacks P3 (Minamoto) with Manji Sai (c1018-2)
